hooks.statusMessage: Checking lint, format, types, tests, web
hooks.command: out=$( { uv sync --locked && npm --prefix web ci && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ty check && uv run pytest && npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix web test ; } 2>&1 ) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; echo 'Definition of Done failed. Fix the failures above before completing this task.' >&2; exit 2; }
